description: Elections Commission - Notify the Name of W. M. Wijekoon Banda as a member of hte Hunupola of Ibbagamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Ibbagamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes at the local government level, including the nomination and declaration of an elected member to fill the vacant seat, which falls under the Elections classification category.
